title: ANT or ENT?
kidRule: A-N-T and E-N-T sound just the same at the end of a word, so there is no sure rule and each word has to be remembered. A good trick is to say the word in a slow robot voice, like im-por-TANT and dif-fer-ENT, so you can hear the vowel.
hint: The ending sounds like 'unt', but its vowel is hiding. Say the word in your slow robot voice. Which vowel belongs in the ending?
reminder: This 'unt' ending has two spellings: A-N-T and E-N-T. If your first try did not work, try the other one!

check.question: Why do we have to remember that IMPORTANT ends with A-N-T?
check.correctAnswer: Because A-N-T and E-N-T sound the same at the end of a word, so we can't tell just by listening!
distractors: Because every long word ends with A-N-T
Because A-N-T always comes after the letter T
